definitions.explanation: A visible mass of water vapor in the sky.

examples.english: There are clouds in the sky.

examples.japanese: {雲|くも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。

examples.english: White clouds are over the mountains.

examples.japanese: {雲|くも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Sunlight was visible through a gap in the clouds.

notes:
{雲|くも} means cloud - visible water vapor floating in the sky.

WATCH OUT:
{雲|くも} (cloud) vs. ⟦{蜘蛛|くも}→蜘蛛：02203_kumo⟧ (spider) - same pronunciation, different kanji.

TYPES OF CLOUDS:
- ⟦{雨雲|あまぐも}→雨雲：22808_amagumo⟧: rain cloud
- ⟦{入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}→入道雲：10085_nyuudougumo⟧: cumulonimbus (towering summer clouds)
- ⟦{綿雲|わたぐも}→綿雲：noentry⟧: cumulus (fluffy clouds)
- ⟦{鰯雲|いわしぐも}→鰯雲：noentry⟧: cirrocumulus (mackerel sky)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {雲|くも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: clouds appear
- {雲|くも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: clouds drift
- {雲|くも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つかむ→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧: vague, elusive (lit. like grasping clouds)
- ⟦{雲海|うんかい}→雲海：18222_unkai⟧: sea of clouds (scenic view from mountains)

WEATHER:
- {雲|くも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: cloudy
- ⟦{曇|くも}り→曇り：02875_kumori⟧: cloudy weather (related word)
